tasks.description: Implement the agreed routine soil check completion wire on a
constraints: Accepted base 76ba906. Return a valid unified Git patch in the JSON patch field, with exact source context. Controller owns writes and verification.

Exact wire: POST /commands, command_name=care.check_soil.complete, plant_id and operation_id in the established envelope. payload_json contains only rule_id (UUID), expected_care_revision (positive int32), due_local_date (YYYY-MM-DD), occurred_at (ISO 8601 instant) and timezone (IANA). Successful receipt: plant_id, rule_id, care_revision, occurrence_key, due_local_date, task_id, entry_id, state=completed, SQL watermark. Same owner and exact operation/body required on replay.

Add stable typed command envelope and typed completion receipt in the existing owner-bound sendOutboxCommand transport. Validate operation/card/rule/revision/due and retry body through local CollectionWireTests. Pass EN and remove installation credential like refresh.

Do not wire the command into a switch that silently discards accepted state. If OutboxCommandResult is expanded, the relevant existing Swift exhaustive switches must compile and any use of this route is fixture-only until the next package. Prefer a bound dedicated transport method if it keeps the current engine and product behavior unchanged.
Scope transport only. No UI, LocalStore, Engine, project files, live work or speculative unauthenticated fallback.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build and unit tests verify exact typed completion and owner-bound transport.
